adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, new code unconditionally performs a refresh-token `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then immediately `prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning the `jsforce.Connection`. This path is not gated by `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and does not use the newly introduced `refreshOAuthTokens` helper, so it will always do a remote round-trip + DB write whenever this code path runs, even when credential sharing/sync is effectively "off". Additionally, because it bypasses `refreshOAuthTokens`, Salesforce never consults `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, making it inconsistent with other integrations changed in this diff that route refreshes through the sync endpoint when enabled.
